system

user

Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**FADE IN:**

**INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY**

The camera pans across a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all stands 127-year-old JASPER JENKINS, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is presented with a certificate and a gold medal, and the crowd erupts in applause.

**JASPER** (V.O)
I Never Thought I'd See The Day. A Century And A Quarter Of Life, And I'm Still Standing.

**CUT TO:**

**INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT**

Jasper lies in bed, the gold medal and certificate displayed proudly on his nightstand. He gazes at the ceiling, a look of nostalgia washing over his face.

**JASPER** (V.O)
I Remember When I First Heard The Theory. Quantum Immortality. The Idea That Our Universe Is A Multiverse, And That Every Time A Decision Is Made, The Universe Branches Off Into Infinite Parallel Realities.

**CUT TO:**

**INT. JASPER'S MIND - NIGHT**

Jasper's eyes glaze over as he becomes lost in thought. He begins to pace back and forth in his bed, his mind racing with the implications of the theory.

**JASPER** (V.O)
What If I'm Not Really Dead? What If I'm Just Living In A Different Reality? What If I've Been Alive For Centuries, And I Just Don't Remember?

**CUT TO:**

**INT. JASPER'S MIND - LATER**

Jasper's pace becomes more frantic, his breathing quickening. He starts to see visions of himself as a young man, living a life he never knew he had. He sees himself as a scientist, working on a top-secret project to harness the power of quantum immortality.

**JASPER** (V.O)
I Remember The Feel Of The Sun On My Face, The Taste Of Fresh Air. I Remember The Sound Of Children Laughing. I Remember The Feel Of Love.

**CUT TO:**

**INT. JASPER'S MIND - LATER**

Jasper's visions become more distorted, his mind fragmenting into a thousand different realities. He sees himself as a god, ruling over a universe of infinite possibilities. He sees himself as a monster, consumed by madness and despair.

**JASPER** (V.O)
I Don't Know What's Real Anymore. I Don't Know What's True. I Don't Know If I'm Still Alive.

**CUT TO:**

**INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - LATER**

Jasper collapses onto his bed, his mind shattered by the weight of his own imagination. He lies there, staring at the ceiling, as the camera zooms out to reveal the infinite possibilities of the multiverse.

**FADE TO BLACK.**
